# Design System Master File — Pixel Game Kit (Web)

> **LOGIC:** When building a specific page, first check `design-system/pages/[page-name].md`.
> If that file exists, its rules **override** this Master file. If not, follow the rules below.

**Project:** Pixel Game Kit — web app (`web/`, Phase 6 MVP)
**Generated:** 2026-07-25 (auto-generated by `ui-ux-pro-max --design-system`, then **hand-corrected** — see Override Notes)
**Category:** Developer Tool / IDE (image-processing utility for indie game devs + pixel artists)
**Design Dials:** Variance 3/10 (Centered / Minimal) | Motion 3/10 (Subtle) | Density 7/10 (Standard)

> **Override Notes (why this differs from the raw auto-generated output):**
> The `--design-system` tool biases toward **marketing landing pages** (it returned "Exaggerated Minimalism" style + "Operations Landing" pattern + scroll-reveal GSAP — all fashion/portfolio/landing aesthetics). Pixel Game Kit's web app is an **interactive tool**, not a landing page. The Product-domain search confirmed the right fit is **"Developer Tool / IDE" → Dark Mode + Minimalism + Flat, Bento/panel layout**. This Master file keeps the auto-generated **colors / typography / spacing / shadows / anti-patterns / checklist** (all sound) and overrides **style / layout pattern / motion / component specs** to be tool-appropriate.

---

## Global Rules

### Color Palette

Dark "code dark + run green" — terminal/dev-tool aesthetic. Matches the existing trial `index.html` (`#0d1117` bg, `#238636` green button).

| Role | Hex | CSS Variable | shadcn token |
|------|-----|--------------|--------------|
| Background | `#0F172A` | `--color-background` | `--background` (slate-950-ish) |
| Foreground | `#F8FAFC` | `--color-foreground` | `--foreground` |
| Primary / panel | `#1E293B` | `--color-primary` | `--card` / `--popover` (slate-800) |
| Secondary | `#334155` | `--color-secondary` | `--secondary` (slate-700) |
| Muted | `#272F42` | `--color-muted` | `--muted` |
| Border | `#475569` (lighter for visibility on dark: `#334155` hairline) | `--color-border` | `--border` |
| Accent / CTA | `#22C55E` | `--color-accent` | `--primary` (green-500, "run") |
| Destructive | `#EF4444` | `--color-destructive` | `--destructive` |
| Ring / focus | `#22C55E` (accent, NOT slate — needs visibility on dark) | `--color-ring` | `--ring` |

**Notes:** Dark mode is the default and primary; light mode is a non-goal for MVP. Accent green doubles as the focus ring (slate rings are invisible on slate bg — the auto-gen `--ring: #1E293B` was a bug).

### Typography

- **Font:** Inter (single family, weights 400/500/600/700) — "developer tools, precision, clean, high-end utility."
- **Mood:** dark, technical, precise, professional.
- **Google Fonts:** `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');`
- **Sizes (tool scale, NOT marketing oversized):** body 14px (dense tool), labels/caption 12-13px, section headings 16-18px, app title 20-24px. **No hero/oversized type** (the auto-gen `clamp(3rem 10vw 12rem)` is rejected — that's landing-page).
- **Mono fallback:** `ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", monospace` for metadata/stats (dimensions, color counts, hex codes) — reinforces the dev-tool feel.

### Spacing Variables (Density 7/10 — Standard, tool-appropriate)

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--space-xs` | `4px` | Tight icon gaps |
| `--space-sm` | `8px` | Inline spacing, form field gaps |
| `--space-md` | `12-16px` | Panel padding, control gaps |
| `--space-lg` | `20-24px` | Panel internal padding |
| `--space-xl` | `32px` | Between major panels |

### Shadow Depths (dark-theme adjusted — shadows are subtle on dark; rely on borders + slight elevation)

| Level | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--shadow-sm` | `0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)` | Subtle lift |
| `--shadow-md` | `0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)` | Panels, popovers |
| `--shadow-lg` | `0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)` | Modals, candidate thumbnails on hover |

### Radii

Tight, precise (tool aesthetic, not soft/consumer): `--radius-sm 6px`, `--radius-md 8px`, `--radius-lg 12px`. shadcn default radius is fine.

---

## Style Direction

**Style:** Dark Mode + Minimalism + Flat (Developer Tool / IDE) — *not* "Exaggerated Minimalism."

- **Keywords:** functional minimalism, flat, high contrast, precise, terminal/monitor vibe, content-first (the image is the content).
- **Principles:** flat surfaces (no gradients/glassmorphism), hairline borders for panel separation, generous negative space around the image canvas, restraint on color (green is the ONLY chromatic accent; everything else is slate).
- **Pixel-art-specific:** all result/thumbnail/candidate images render with `image-rendering: pixelated` (crucial — never blur pixel art). This is a hard rule for every `<img>` showing processed output.

---

## Workspace Layout (NOT a landing funnel)

The app is a **single-workspace tool**, not a scrollable landing page. Layout = fixed viewport, panel grid (bento-style):

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Header: app title · status (WASM loading / ready)           │
├──────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  LEFT PANEL      │  CENTER/RIGHT — CANVAS                    │
│  (controls)      │                                           │
│                  │  ┌─ CompareView (slider, pixelated) ─┐    │
│  UploadZone      │  │   orig ◄━━► result                │    │
│  (drag/paste)    │  └────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                  │                                           │
│  ConfigForm      │  Summary bar: dims · colors · time · det  │
│  (RJSF, grouped) │                                           │
│                  │  CandidateGrid (top-3 thumbnails)         │
│  [Process] btn   │                                           │
│  [Download] btn  │                                           │
└──────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **Two-pane, fixed height** (no page scroll in the workspace; panels scroll internally if needed).
- Left = controls (≈320–360px), right = canvas (flex-1, the image dominates).
- Responsive: on `<1024px`, stack vertically (controls above canvas). MVP targets desktop first (indie devs on laptops); mobile is best-effort.
- CandidateGrid can sit under the canvas or in a collapsible right rail — designer's call at Stage 1.

## Component Specs (dark-consistent; implement via shadcn/ui)

> Implement with **shadcn/ui** components (Button, Card, Input, Select, Slider, Dialog, Tabs, Tooltip) themed to the palette above. The raw CSS below is the visual contract, not the implementation.

- **Primary button (Process):** green `#22C55E` bg, white text, `--radius-md`, `--space-sm md` padding, `transition 150ms`. Hover: slightly lighter green (`#16A34A`). Disabled: `opacity 0.5`, `cursor-not-allowed`.
- **Secondary/Ghost button (Download):** transparent bg, slate-700 border, foreground text. Hover: slate-800 bg.
- **Panel (Card):** bg `--color-primary` (`#1E293B`), `1px solid #334155` hairline border, `--radius-lg`, `--space-lg` padding. **No hover lift** (panels aren't clickable cards — the auto-gen `.card:hover` lift is rejected).
- **Input/Select (dark):** bg `#0F172A`, `1px solid #334155`, foreground text, `--radius-md`. Focus: border `#22C55E` + `0 0 0 2px #22C55E33` ring (visible on dark). **The auto-gen light-mode input (`#E2E8F0` border) is rejected.**
- **Dialog/Modal (dark):** overlay `rgba(0,0,0,0.6)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)`; modal bg `#1E293B`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-lg`. **The auto-gen white modal is rejected.**
- **Image (pixel art):** `image-rendering: pixelated; image-rendering: crisp-edges;` on every result/candidate/thumbnail `<img>`. `max-width: 100%`, `height: auto` (responsive, no overflow).
- **Icons:** Lucide (SVG), 16–20px, `currentColor`. **No emojis as icons.**

---

## Motion (micro-interactions, NOT scroll-reveal)

The auto-gen "Scroll Reveal GSAP" is a marketing pattern — **rejected**. For a tool:

- **Micro-interactions only:** button press (`transform: scale(0.98)`, 100ms), panel mount fade (`opacity 0→1`, 150ms on first render), loading spinner during processing, result-image crossfade on reprocess (`opacity`, 200ms).
- **Durations:** 100–200ms (snappy — tools feel responsive, not cinematic). Easing: `ease-out`.
- **`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`** → disable all non-essential motion (keep only opacity for state changes).
- **No layout-shift animations** (don't animate width/height/top — use transform/opacity).
- **Processing feedback:** the Process button shows a spinner + "处理中…" while the Worker runs; UI stays interactive (U12.5).

---

## Anti-Patterns (Do NOT Use)

- ❌ Light mode default (dark is primary for MVP)
- ❌ Oversized hero typography (`clamp(3rem 10vw 12rem)` etc.) — that's landing-page
- ❌ Scroll-reveal / scroll-triggered animation — that's marketing
- ❌ Hover-lift on non-clickable panels (layout shift)
- ❌ Emojis as icons — use Lucide SVG
- ❌ Missing `cursor: pointer` on clickables
- ❌ Slate focus ring on slate bg (invisible) — use green accent ring
- ❌ Low contrast text (4.5:1 minimum — `#F8FAFC` on `#0F172A` ✓; watch muted `#272F42` for body, use it only for secondary/caption)
- ❌ Blurry pixel art — every output image MUST be `image-rendering: pixelated`
- ❌ Layout-shifting hovers; instant (0ms) state changes
- ❌ Light-mode component defaults (white modals/inputs) on the dark theme

---

## Pre-Delivery Checklist

- [ ] Dark theme applied consistently (no stray white/light surfaces)
- [ ] All output/candidate images render `pixelated` (no blur)
- [ ] Lucide icons throughout; no emojis
- [ ] `cursor: pointer` on all clickables
- [ ] Focus rings visible (green accent, not slate)
- [ ] Transitions 100–200ms; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- [ ] Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (foreground on bg; watch muted text)
- [ ] Worker non-blocking: large-image processing keeps UI interactive
- [ ] Responsive at 1024px (stack) / 1440px (two-pane); mobile best-effort
- [ ] No horizontal scroll on the workspace
